journeys.title: Finding Peace
journeys.description: Five days learning to let go of anxiety and rest in God's presence.

journeys.title: Growing in Faith
journeys.description: Five days building a faith that holds steady, not just when it's easy.

journeys.title: Overcoming Fear
journeys.description: Five days facing what frightens you with real, scriptural courage.

days.title: Bring It to God
days.verseText: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
days.reflection: Peace doesn't start with fixing the problem. It starts with putting the problem into someone else's hands. What are you still carrying that you haven't actually handed over yet?
days.prayer: Lord, I bring you what's been weighing on me today. I don't need to solve it right now — I just need to stop carrying it alone. Guard my heart and mind. Amen.

days.title: A Different Kind of Peace
days.verseText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
days.reflection: The world's peace depends on circumstances going right. This peace doesn't. What would it look like to feel steady today, even if nothing around you changes?
days.prayer: Jesus, give me the peace that doesn't depend on my circumstances lining up. Let my heart be still even in the middle of what's unresolved. Amen.

days.title: A Mind Stayed on God
days.verseText: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
days.reflection: Peace here isn't passive — it's a mind that's been deliberately fixed on something steady. What keeps pulling your attention away today, and what would it take to redirect it?
days.prayer: Father, keep my mind fixed on you today, especially when my thoughts want to wander toward worry. I trust you with what I can't control. Amen.

days.title: Strength and Peace Together
days.verseText: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
days.reflection: Peace isn't the absence of hard things — it often comes paired with the strength to face them. Where do you need both today, not just one or the other?
days.prayer: Lord, give me strength for what's ahead and peace to carry it well. I don't need to feel nothing — I need to feel steady. Amen.

days.title: Let Peace Rule
days.verseText: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
days.reflection: This verse treats peace like a decision, not just a feeling — something you let govern you. Looking back on this week, where did you let peace rule, and where did you let something else take over instead?
days.prayer: God, thank you for meeting me this week. Help peace be the thing that governs my heart going forward, not anxiety, not control. Amen.

days.title: The Substance of What You Hope For
days.verseText: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
days.reflection: Faith isn't pretending you're certain. It's holding onto something real even before you can see how it resolves. What are you hoping for right now that you haven't seen come true yet?
days.prayer: Lord, grow in me a faith that holds on even when I can't see the outcome. Let hope be substance, not just a feeling. Amen.

days.title: Faith Comes by Hearing
days.verseText: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
days.reflection: Faith isn't something you either have or don't — it grows the more you actually take in God's word, not just think about faith in the abstract. What's one thing you read this week that actually stayed with you?
days.prayer: Father, let your word take root in me, not just pass through. Build my faith the ordinary way — by paying attention. Amen.

days.title: Walking, Not Seeing
days.verseText: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
days.reflection: Sight wants proof before it moves. Faith moves first. Where in your life are you waiting for certainty before you'll take the next step?
days.prayer: Lord, help me take the next step even without seeing the whole path. I trust that you can see what I can't. Amen.

days.title: Faith Under Pressure
days.verseText: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
days.reflection: This is a hard verse to actually believe, not just quote — that the hard season is doing something in you, not just to you. What's testing your faith right now, and what might it be building?
days.prayer: God, I won't pretend this is easy. But I ask that you use what I'm going through to build something steady in me. Amen.

days.title: Believing Prayer
days.verseText: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
days.reflection: Looking back on this week, has your faith grown quietly in a way you can actually name? What's one thing you're praying about with real, not performed, belief?
days.prayer: Lord, thank you for this week. I bring you what I'm hoping for, and I choose to pray it in faith rather than doubt. Amen.

days.title: Not a Spirit of Fear
days.verseText: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
days.reflection: Fear can feel like it just happens to you, but this verse names it as something you're not required to carry — power, love, and a clear mind are the alternative on offer. What fear has been running the show lately?
days.prayer: Lord, I don't want fear steering my decisions. Give me power, love, and a clear mind in its place today. Amen.

days.title: Strong and Courageous
days.verseText: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
days.reflection: Courage here isn't the absence of fear — it's moving forward with the confidence that you're not doing it alone. Where do you need to take a next step despite being afraid?
days.prayer: God, thank you that you go with me into what scares me. Help me move forward anyway, not because I'm fearless, but because you're present. Amen.

days.title: Whom Shall I Fear?
days.verseText: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
days.reflection: This is a question, not just a statement — David is actually working it out loud. Try asking it about your specific fear: given who God is, what does this fear actually have power over?
days.prayer: Lord, you are my light and my strength. Help me actually believe that, not just say it, when I face what scares me today. Amen.

days.title: I Will Strengthen You
days.verseText: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee.
days.reflection: Notice how personal this is — not a general promise, but I am with thee, I will strengthen thee. What would it look like to receive this as spoken directly to you today?
days.prayer: Father, thank you for staying close instead of leaving me to face this alone. Strengthen me for what's ahead. Amen.

days.title: Perfect Love Casts Out Fear
days.verseText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
days.reflection: This week's journey ends here: fear and love can't both fully occupy the same space. Looking back, where did love actually push fear out this week — even a little?
days.prayer: Lord, thank you for walking this week with me. Let your love keep pushing out what fear tries to hold onto in me. Amen.
